comment:
* Extends {@link List} to add the capability to make the list immutable and inspect if it is * modifiable. * *

All implementations must support efficient random access.

methods.name: void makeImmutable()
methods.comment:
* Makes this list immutable. All subsequent modifications will throw an {@link
     * UnsupportedOperationException}.

methods.name: boolean isModifiable()
methods.comment: * Returns whether this list can be modified via the publicly accessible {@link List} methods.

methods.name: ProtobufList<E> mutableCopyWithCapacity(int capacity)
methods.comment: Returns a mutable clone of this list with the specified capacity.
